18. Based on my recollection of the suspension extensions submitted by China Status however, in relation to each of the 8 buildings, the buildings’ FH / HR system remained suspended from the date of the initial suspension up until the commencement of the fire on 26th November 2025.

19. Each of the extension notices submitted to the FSD were prepared, signed, and submitted by me on behalf of China Status, except for some extensions made in November 2025, as I was out of town for a period of time. I understand that Mr. Yim processed the extension notices when I was not in Hong Kong during this period.

(iii)  
[Procurement of additional fire extinguishers](underline)

20. At the initial stage, during the period when China Status was approached and engaged by PC&E in connection with this project, I informed Mr. Cheung of PC&E that we anticipate the FSD requiring additional fire extinguishers to be installed in buildings further to SDNs being submitted. Mr Cheung agreed that as part of the engagement, China Status would procure these additional fire extinguishers. After China Status had been engaged, I understand that our other director Mr. Yim handled the procurement and delivery of said fire extinguishers to Wang Fuk Court.

(iv)  
[FSI shutdown notices](underline)

21. In relation to each SDN submitted to the FSD, myself or Ms. Chung under my supervision, would prepare FSI Shutdown Notices for the corresponding building, and send them to PC&E so they may arrange for the notices to be displayed in the affected building. There were instances where said FSI shutdown notices were prepared in batches in advance, for efficiency purposes.
